about_the_game:
————Preface: The Encounter between Eternal Night and Snake Shadow
Scene: Ruins of Leifeng Pagoda, rainstorm pouring down. The undercurrent of the western Styx and the mist of the eastern underworld intertwine in the rain, forming a strange purple black vortex.

Hades (hunting in a black robe, with chains wrapped around her fingertips and a withered mandala at the end of the chain): "The gatekeepers of the Eastern Hell are actually two women?" She chuckled lightly, and the chains wrapped around Bai Suzhen's snake tail like snakes. "This tail... is more like a pet of Hell than my dark dog

Bai Suzhen (with her green hair stuck to her pale face by the rain, but her fingertips glistening with green light, her magical power turning into a barrier to block the chains): "The Western Grim Reaper? Your waters of the Styx cannot break the seal of the Leifeng Pagoda." She glanced towards the tower base - where the relics of the Female Fahai were buried, faintly burning.

Hades (suddenly exerting force, the chain turning into a black butterfly and dissipating): "Interesting. You're protecting this tower, but your enemy is under it?" She lightly tapped her fingertips, and a crack opened on the ground, revealing the golden Buddha statue of the goddess Fahai - half of Hades' underworld token embedded in the forehead of the Buddha statue.

Bai Suzhen (pupils suddenly contracting): "Did you... touch her soul

N ü Fahai (the Buddha suddenly opened his eyes, but his voice carried a double echo - the interweaving of Buddha nature and demon nature): "Amitabha Buddha... benefactor, your underworld token was originally a seal for me to suppress my inner demons." She slowly stood up, her robe turned into blood red armor, and her Zen staff wrapped around Hades' chains. "Now, we are both prisoners of each other

Hades (raising his eyebrows, the chains suddenly skyrocketed and wrapped around the neck of the female Fahai): "Little monk, your Buddhist heart has long been scorched by my dark fire. Why don't you... be my guide to the East

Female Fahai (the Zen staff suddenly pierced Hades' shoulder, but no blood flowed - black sand gushed out from the wound): "Your underworld lacks a Buddha to suppress rebellion." Her fingertips brushed Hades' cheek, and the Buddha's light and black mist exploded between the two. "And I, on the other hand, lack a physical body capable of carrying demonic energy

Bai Suzhen (suddenly wagging her tail, the snake scales turning into sharp blades to cut off the chains): "Enough! One of you is a madman who wants to devour the Eastern Dead World, and the other is a crazy monk who wants to become a Buddha through magic!" Her fingertips lit up with blue light, but instead of attacking, she forcibly pulled the two apart. "Hades, if you want to control life and death, first ask my millennium cultivation if you agree; Fahai, if you want to become a demon, first pass my level

Hades (licking the black sand on her shoulder, suddenly laughing): "Interesting! Interesting! The rules of the Eastern Hell... are even more chaotic than my River Styx!" She suddenly leaned close to Bai Suzhen, with countless chains wrapped around her waist under her black robe. "Why don't we join forces? Can you help me kill all those false benevolence and righteousness Buddhas, and I can help you overturn this tower and let you reunite with Xu Xian's reincarnation

N ü Fahai (the Zen staff pounded heavily on the ground, and the golden body of the Buddha statue shattered inch by inch, revealing her original face - which was seven tenths similar to Bai Suzhen): "Hades, your ability to sow discord is not as good as your underworld fire." She suddenly grabbed Hades' wrist, and the Buddha light and black mist intertwined in her eyes. "And you, Bai Suzhen... do you think you hate me? What you hate is yourself who has been tamed by Buddhism

Bai Suzhen (the green light skyrocketed, the snake tail turned into a human leg, but stumbled back): "No... you're talking nonsense

Hades (taking the opportunity to press the Hades token into the female Fahai's heart): "It's done, little monk. You open the door to the Eastern Hell for me, and I'll kill the Buddha in your heart for you

Female Fahai (the Buddha's light suddenly extinguished, leaving only demonic nature in her eyes): "Deal

When the rainstorm stopped suddenly, under the ruins of Leifeng Pagoda, the shadows of the three people twisted into strange symbols in the moonlight - Hades' chains wrapped around NvFahai's Buddhist staff, while Bai Suzhen's green light was swallowed by the black fog.

————————Background of key figures

Hades, a tyrant in the Western underworld, witnessed his mother being imprisoned in the depths of Tartarus during his childhood. From then on, he became obsessed with subverting the "numbness of the eternal" and sealed his mother's soul with his left eye. The Mandala branches concealed a variant of the Eastern Mengpo Tang, attempting to rewrite the laws of life and death through chaos;

Bai Suzhen, a thousand year old snake demon, was voluntarily killed by the Zhenleifeng Pagoda to save Xu Xian, but the snake tail gave birth to lotus under the erosion of Buddhism. The fragments of Nuwa mending the sky in her body can reverse life and death, but lead to the collapse of heaven and earth. The sisters relationship with Nufa Hai in her past life in the deep memory was forcibly erased, and the paradox of love and freedom tore her into a "Buddhist demon community";

Female Fahai, the holy woman of the Buddhist sect, was enchanted by Bai Suzhen, but maintained the seal of Leifeng Pagoda with her demonic nature. Her heart was replaced by Hades' underworld token, and every time she touched the Dharma, her flesh and blood were consumed. She was actually Hades' exiled sister to the East, and her memory was erased due to her resistance to the tyranny of the underworld. She became a prisoner of "using evil to suppress evil" - all three of them were regular prisoners, but in the struggle for life and death power, they became mirrors and sacrifices of each other's obsession.


————————Gameplay
Plot twists and turns: The game plot is full of ups and downs, with main quests lasting 3-10 hours, filled with suspense, thriller elements, and plot twists, immersing players in it.
Card turn combat: Players need to use strategies to carefully combine cards and engage in intense battles with enemies in turn based combat. Reasonably matching heroes can produce double the combat effect!
Random function on the battlefield: Lucky bosses, item stores, lottery opportunities, and monsters of different levels randomly appear on the battlefield, adding many variables to the game. Every time we choose a forward route, it is a deep consideration of our combat strategy.
Hero Recruitment: Players can recruit various heroes to expand their combat team and add more possibilities to battles.
Hero Enhancement: Through upgrades, equipment upgrades, and other methods, comprehensively enhance the abilities of heroes, making them stronger and invincible in battles.
Hero Team: Players can freely combine hero combinations to fully leverage the advantages of team collaboration and achieve a combat effect of 1+1>2.
Hero Returning: For dissatisfied heroes, players can perform a reheating operation to retrain or acquire resources, achieving the rational utilization of resources.
Heroic cultivation: A special dual cultivation system with female heroes is set up to enhance the tacit understanding between heroes and improve overall strength during the cultivation process.
Victory Reward: After winning, players will receive a large amount of rich rewards to help their characters grow quickly and unlock more game content.
Resource trading: Players can freely buy and sell resources within the game, optimize resource allocation, and maximize the value of resources.
Copy unlocking: As the game progresses, players can unlock multiple copies, experience different challenges and fun, and explore more mysteries of the game world.
————————Game objectives
Through battles, gradually unlock new storylines and drive the development of the overall story content. In the end, players will challenge the ultimate enemy. If the challenge is successful, the overall plot and story content can be completed. However, this is not the end of the game. Players can also repeat the story content, challenge stronger enemies, complete high-level challenge goals, and constantly break through themselves.

content_descriptors.notes: The female characters in the game wear revealing clothing. Please do not start playing games in the workplace
